decision_rule: Recommend Work only when broader external-document discovery or long multi-source synthesis is materially likely to improve coverage beyond the current ChatGPT batch. Keep repo-native classification, normalization, audit, and mathematical receiver judgment with ChatGPT.

handoff_contract.work_request_rule: When recommended, emit a ready-to-paste Work request naming the exact structure IDs or barrier/receiver, the external search objective, exclusions, and the evidence expected back. When not recommended, WORK_REQUEST must be empty.
handoff_contract.work_result_rule: Work results are leads, not self-certifying evidence. ChatGPT must map returned theorems to exact repo variables, hypotheses, quantitative losses, provenance, and receiver applicability before any ACTIVE arsenal promotion.

codex_interaction.note: Codex remains for repository-mechanical failures or large deterministic repair/reindex work; Work is for external literature breadth and long document synthesis. Neither recommendation auto-invokes another product mode.
